Fällt der Raum schneller als dieser Wert: If the room temperature falls faster than this value per hour, a window counts as open. The automation then suspends its decisions for 30 minutes.
Fällt der Raum unter Soll minus diesen W: If the room falls below the setpoint minus this value, the automation ends the setback immediately.
Liegt die gedämpfte Außentemperatur um d: If the damped outdoor temperature is above the limit by the hysteresis, the automation switches the heating circuit to hot water only. If it is below by the hysteresis and the room is cooler than the setpoint minus 0.5 K, the circuit returns to its program.
So lange bleibt der Heizkreis mindestens: The heating circuit stays at least this long in its program or on hot water only before the automation switches again. A room that is too cold always takes precedence.

Wie träge die gedämpfte Außentemperatur: How slowly the damped outdoor temperature follows the sensor. A larger value gives short afternoon warmth less weight. Guide values: radiators 5 h, mixed 15 h, underfloor heating 25 h.
Zu dieser Uhrzeit prüft die Automatik, o: At this time the automation checks whether a sunny day lies ahead and then sets the setback.
Über so viele Tage vergleicht die Automa: Over this many days the automation compares forecast and measurement and adjusts the forecast. A short window reacts faster, a long one varies less.
